sections.title: Clothing & garment equipment
sections.intro: We manufacture and supply industrial garment equipment and produce clothing lines for apparel factories, fashion retailers, and international brands worldwide.
offered: Custom fashion pieces & OEM production runs
sections.materials: Industrial garment machinery parts, knit & woven cotton, poly blends, jersey, pique, poplin, twill, denim, and technical fabrics.
sections.orderApproach: Send us your technical specification, machine requirement, or garment tech pack. We quote within 24–48 hours, produce prototypes or samples in 7–10 days, and dispatch worldwide with full export clearance.

sections.title: Accessories, trims & packaging supply
sections.intro: We supply the complete spectrum of branded packaging, trims, and accessories to garment manufacturers and global brand houses. Custom print, weave, and finishing available for all items.
offered: Branded packaging: rigid boxes, mailers, cartons, tissue wrap
Woven and printed labels (neck, care, size, woven badges)
Hang tags, price tags, barcode stickers, and seal tags
Poly bags, biodegradable garment bags, and vacuum packs
Buttons, zippers, pullers, eyelets, and metal trims
sections.materials: Kraft paper, cardboard, corrugated board, biodegradable poly, woven polyester, metal, and brass — tested to international compliance standards.
sections.orderApproach: Share your artwork or packaging brief. We prepare pre-production samples and confirm specs before bulk. Lead time 10–21 days from approved artwork with reliable international freight forwarding.

process.title: Enquiry
process.description: Send us your spec, machinery need, or design brief. We respond within 24 hours with a competitive quote and clear timeline.

process.title: Sample & Spec
process.description: We prepare a pre-production sample or technical prototype for your team's review and sign-off.

process.title: Approval
process.description: You approve the sample, and we confirm order specifications, pricing, and dispatch schedule in writing.

process.title: Production
process.description: Full production commences under strict QA. We provide milestone updates so you always know where your order stands.

process.title: Global Delivery
process.description: Finished goods are packed to export standards, inspected, and shipped internationally with full logistics support.
